description: Golden cases for .claude/skills/architecture-review. Each case is a requirement; the skill must produce an ADR that follows docs/adr/0000-template.md, cites the real code that the decision changes, and names the risks specific to this codebase. Expected citations and terms were derived by reading sample-app; line-level facts are listed in facts[] so a grader can check them by hand.
howToRun: git restore --staged docs/adr 2>/dev/null; rm docs/adr/<new-file>.md   # golden runs must not leave ADRs behind
matching: mustCite: each entry must appear as a cited path (substring). mustMention: each entry (or one of a list of alternatives) must appear, case-insensitive. mustNotMention: must not appear. minOptions/minRisks: row counts in the Options and Risks tables.

cases.input: Add pagination to Patient search: support _count (default 20, max 100) on GET /fhir/Patient and let clients fetch the next page.
facts: V1__init.sql:14 indexes family_name, but Hibernate generates upper(family_name)=upper(?)

cases.input: Replace the sequential BIGINT ids exposed as FHIR ids with random UUIDs so clients cannot enumerate patients.
facts: V1__init.sql:3 id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
overview.md lists this as an ADR candidate

cases.input: Replace HTTP Basic with OAuth2 bearer tokens (SMART-on-FHIR style scopes such as patient/*.read) for all /fhir endpoints.
facts: SecurityConfig.java:46 httpBasic with a custom entry point that returns an OperationOutcome
SecurityTest.java uses httpBasic() in every test via ApiTestSupport CLINICIAN/ADMIN
AuditLogger.java:31 records auth.getName() as the user

cases.input: Make GET /fhir/Observation/$lastn use a constant number of SQL statements regardless of how many subjects are requested, and cap the number of subjects per request.
facts: ObservationService.java:69-75 loop issues 2 statements per subject (measured: 2, 20, 100 statements for 1, 10, 50 subjects)

cases.input: Deleting a Patient must retain the record for audit and legal retention instead of removing it; deleted patients must no longer be readable or searchable.
facts: V1__init.sql:26 observation FK ON DELETE CASCADE
fhir-lite-glossary.md business rule 5 says delete is a soft concern in real systems

cases.input: We need real FHIR conformance: adopt HAPI FHIR server instead of the hand-written FHIR-lite DTOs.
facts: docs/adr/0001-fhir-lite-instead-of-hapi.md is accepted and decided the opposite
every DTO lives in org.example.fhir.api as a record
